motion.name: button-background
motion.purpose: Button and queue-row state changes; disabled by prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Full-width form action; the queue uses a compact variant.
components.css: .ds-primary{font:600 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;padding:8px 14px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius, 6px);min-height:40px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 150ms ease-out;background:var(--accent, #246447);color:white;min-height:44px;}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-hover, #174c34);}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){background:#103d29;}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #246447);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-primary:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.58;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none;}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Settings reuse, cancellation, reference removal, and other supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-secondary{font:600 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;padding:8px 14px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius, 6px);min-height:40px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 150ms ease-out;background:var(--surface, #fff);color:var(--ink, #24302a);border-color:#b5c0b7;}.ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--canvas, #edf0ed);}.ds-secondary:active:not(:disabled){background:#dce2dd;}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #246447);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-secondary:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.58;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none;}}

components.name: Text button
components.css: .ds-text{font:600 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;padding:8px 14px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius, 6px);min-height:40px;cursor:pointer;transition:background 150ms ease-out;background:transparent;color:var(--muted, #5c6860);font-size:12px;padding:4px;min-height:32px;}.ds-text:hover:not(:disabled){color:var(--accent, #246447);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;}.ds-text:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #246447);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-text:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.58;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-text{transition:none;}}

components.name: Labeled input
components.description: White editable surface with persistent label and visible keyboard focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-seed">Seed</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-seed" type="text" inputmode="numeric" value="42">
components.css: .ds-label{display:block;font:600 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:var(--ink, #24302a);margin-bottom:7px;}.ds-input{width:100%;min-width:0;font:14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;padding:9px 11px;border:1px solid #b5c0b7;border-radius:var(--radius, 6px);background:var(--surface, #fff);color:var(--ink, #24302a);caret-color:var(--accent, #246447);}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #246447);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-input:disabled{opacity:.65;cursor:default;}@media(max-width:420px){.ds-input{font-size:16px;}}

components.name: Selected queue row
components.description: FIFO job selection with prompt, seed metadata, and written state.
components.css: .ds-job{display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;min-height:40px;padding:11px 10px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:0;text-align:left;background:transparent;font:400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:var(--ink, #24302a);cursor:pointer;transition:background 150ms ease-out;}.ds-job[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#dfece3;}.ds-job:hover{background:#e8ede9;}.ds-job:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #246447);outline-offset:-3px;}.ds-number{color:var(--muted, #5c6860);font-size:11px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-prompt{display:block;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-size:13px;}.ds-meta{display:block;color:var(--muted, #5c6860);font-size:11px;margin-top:2px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-status{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted, #5c6860);}.ds-status[data-status="failed"]{color:var(--error, #9b302a);}.ds-status[data-status="running"],.ds-status[data-status="completed"]{color:var(--accent, #246447);font-weight:600;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-job{transition:none;}}

components.css: .ds-log{border-top:1px solid var(--line, #d6ddd7);padding-top:10px;margin-top:18px;font:14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;}.ds-log summary{width:fit-content;min-height:32px;padding:5px 0;font-weight:550;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted, #5c6860);cursor:pointer;}.ds-log summary:focus-visible,.ds-log pre:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #246447);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-log pre{background:var(--canvas, #edf0ed);color:var(--ink, #24302a);font:12px/1.7 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace;border-radius:var(--radius, 6px);padding:14px;max-height:240px;overflow:auto;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;tab-size:2;}

narrative.overview:
A quiet, compact utility keeps controls legible and lets generated images occupy the largest surface. Light graphite, white fields, forest green actions, and system typography provide the visual hierarchy.

This records the standalone module's implemented system in `web/style.css`, `web/index.html`, and `web/app.js`. Fonts and icons require no network resources; the interface ships no raster artwork.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces separated by tone and thin rules.
Restrained green actions and explicit text states.

rules.name: The Text State Rule
rules.body: Always pair status color with a written state; color alone does not communicate queue progress or failure.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tone and borders for separation, preserving the implemented shadow-free surface hierarchy.

dos: Do use the existing system font stacks and inline SVG icons.
Do preserve visible labels, keyboard focus, and written status messages.
Do let long prompts truncate in queue rows while preserving status and metadata.
donts: Don't add network fonts, remote decorative assets, or external UI dependencies.
Don't use shadows to separate the existing flat surfaces.
Don't crop the generated result to fill its preview frame.
